purpose: Current product and architecture reference for RQ. This file is documentation only; it is not deployed Firebase configuration, a Firestore security policy, or the authoritative database schema.

architecture.frontend: React + Vite PWA served through Cloudflare Pages
architecture.identity: Firebase Authentication; Worker validates identity, role, active session, and garage scope
architecture.database: Cloud Firestore; sensitive writes are performed by the Worker/Admin SDK
architecture.language: Arabic-only user-facing UI with RTL layout
architecture.regionAndBusinessDay: Cairo, Egypt; date-only business values use validated Cairo calendar-date helpers

rules: A new trial grants exactly 100 trial credits.
Trial credits are tracked separately and are not cash revenue.
A regular vehicle entry consumes one eligible credit.
Credit grants, debits, restores, referrals, and commissions must be transactional, idempotent, and auditable.
Delegate commission is exactly 100 EGP once per garage, triggered by its first successful paid credit grant.
retired: Duration, capacity, weekly, or monthly garage packages
Legacy recharge requests and owner-wallet top-ups

Garage.description: Garage account, access/session identity, hourly and overnight rates, and prepaid-credit balances.
notes: The Worker owns authorization and financial decisions.
Do not treat subscription expiry, package capacity, or billingModel fields as active billing rules.

Vehicle.description: Vehicle parking lifecycle and hourly/overnight stay details.
notes: Check-in and check-out are Worker-authoritative and idempotent.
Subscriber eligibility and renewal are server-authoritative.
There is no separate subscriber charge.

Delegate.description: Delegate identity, referral attribution, and commission eligibility.
notes: Delegate commission is governed by docs/PROJECT.md, not by this reference file.

CreditLedgerEntry.description: Auditable record of each prepaid-credit balance transition.

DomainEvent.description: Auditable domain event written transactionally with relevant business mutations.
notes: Consult current Worker implementation for exact event fields and storage paths.

AdminSettings.description: Administrative settings required by active application workflows.
notes: Do not reintroduce legacy wallet or subscription-price settings.

retiredConcepts: Package catalog and package-based garage billing
Supervisor role/schema from the old template
Garage subscriptionExpiry and subscriptionDays as billing authority
Referral reward days and monthly gift balances
safetyNotes: This reference does not define or replace Firestore security rules.
Do not use it to create or migrate production data.
Before changing collections, fields, financial rules, or access control, inspect current code, tests, docs/PROJECT.md, docs/SECURITY.md, and firestore.rules.
Do not infer that an old field should be deleted from stored records merely because it is listed as retired here.
